newsitem.title: USA: Salomon forms alliance with investment firm.
newsitem.headline: Salomon forms alliance with investment firm.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc said on Friday it formed a strategic alliance with Fidelty Investments giving its corporate finance clients exclusive access to Fidelity's retail brokerage and mutual fund clients.
In turn, Fidelity Brokerage Services Inc, the discount brokerage arm of Fidelity Investments, will be able to participate in all equity transactions lead-managed by Salomon Brothers.
As part of the arrangement, Fidelity will become the first discount broker offering access to new issue equity securities on a consistent basis to its retail clients, it said.
The deal also allows Fidelity to distribute Salomon's equity research to retail customers.
Salomon said the alliance is designed to capitalize on both firms distribution strengths.
